title: The Directorist: AI-Powered Business Directory, Listings & Classified Ads WordPress plugin before 8.11 does not verify…
description: The Directorist WordPress plugin versions before 8.11 have a vulnerability where the checkout payment-retry REST action does not verify that the order belongs to the requesting user. This flaw allows any authenticated user, including subscribers, to create payment-attempt records on orders owned by other users.
